assessment_objectives.objective: an inventory of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identities is maintained.
each Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identity is uniquely identified and is not shared across tools, pipelines or workloads.
an accountable owner is assigned to each Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identity and is recorded in the inventory.
the inventory of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identities includes service accounts.
the inventory of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identities includes API keys.
the inventory of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identities includes OAuth grants.
the inventory of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identities includes machine and workload identities.
the inventory of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identities is reconciled against identities present in the identity provider(s), tooling and pipelines at a defined frequency.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least annually, and upon significant change to CAA tooling or pipelines
